name: think-bigger
title_zh: 29 个思维脚手架，专治想问题只想一层
tagline_zh: 写方案、做决策、复盘时总漏掉关键角度？这套技能包像一摞提问卡片，逼你把每个念头翻面再翻面，直到看见第二层、第三层。
tagline_en: Stuck seeing only one side of a problem? This pack of 29 skill cards makes you flip every idea until you spot the.
why_zh: 不是给你答案，是给你一套追问的姿势。每个技能都逼你换一个坐标系看问题，让思考从单点蹦极变成多面体旋转。
why_en: Not answers, but interrogation moves. Each skill forces a coordinate shift, turning one-shot thinking into a habit of rotating.
limit_zh: 只提供思维框架和提问模板，不产出成品文档；需要你自己有具体问题并愿意动笔回答；29 个技能间无编排，需自行挑选组合。
limit_en: Frameworks and prompts only, no finished artifacts. You must bring a real problem and write. No orchestration; pick and combine manually.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 29 thinking scaffolds that force second-order thoughts
